game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge, a bridge in a blizzard: the innkeeper must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Blizzard Bridge: a bridge in a blizzard
core_gameplay_loop: In Blizzard Bridge, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against snow wraiths. Each round, a new warm lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of warm lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Blizzard Bridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Blizzard Bridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 300 within 45 seconds.
